svg.text: Task Consistency Floor (Min–Max), Deliverable Code Volume vs. Quality & Token Streaming Speed
Why worst-task floor separates reliable production models from spiky specialists, and why writing 7,000+ lines or streaming at 200 tok/s does not guarantee fast wins
A. 8-Task Quality Consistency Floor (Min → Mean → Max)
Green = worst task ≥ 86.2 (zero weak spots across all 8 formats) · Wide bars = task volatility
B. Does Writing More Code Mean Higher Visual Quality?
Total lines of deliverable code written across the 6 text/code tasks vs. Mean Dual-Judge Score
C. Why Fast Token Streaming (tok/s) ≠ Fast Task Completion
Output speed (tok/s) vs. 8-task wall time · Low turn counts (61–85 turns) beat raw 200 tok/s streaming
